Legend & how this page works
MITRE Navigator
Covered technique — at least one rule in rules/sigma/ maps to it. The coloured left rail is the best verdict among those rules: green PASS, amber NOT VERIFIED, red FAIL, grey N/A. A covered sub-technique carries the same verdict as a dot instead of a tint. Partial: the technique itself has no rule, but one or more of its sub-techniques does. The n/m badge counts them; expand the cell to see which. No rule maps to this item yet — a gap. Still clickable: its panel shows what ATT&CK says it is, and that there is no vault note or blurb for it yet. At least one covering rule FAILed, even though the cell shows a better verdict.
Glossary panel
Click any cell — or a tactic header — to open its panel: the short Mi ez blurb from scripts/docs/mitre_glossary/blurbs.yaml, a link to the matching note in this vault if one exists, and the rules that cover it. Blurbs are written for every covered and partial item; uncovered items say so plainly instead of showing invented text.
Same matrix, filters and coverage colours as the rule browser's MITRE Navigator — the cyan accent (instead of the rule browser's amber) is only there so the two pages can't be mistaken for each other.
